tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: Submit Pick'ems for Current Week Matchups
stories.goal: pick winners for all matchups in the current week before the lock deadline
stories.benefit: I can participate in the weekly pick'ems competition and prove my prediction skills
acceptanceCriteria: System displays all matchups for current week with pick selection interface
User can select winner for each matchup by clicking/tapping on team
Selected picks are visually indicated with highlight, checkmark, or selection state
System shows lock time/deadline for pick submissions prominently
User can submit picks even if not all matchups are picked (partial submission allowed)
System confirms successful submission with visual feedback or message

stories.title: Edit Picks Before Lock Time
stories.goal: change my picks for matchups that have not yet locked
stories.benefit: I can adjust my predictions based on new information like injuries or lineup changes
acceptanceCriteria: User can return to pick'ems page and see their previously submitted picks
User can change any pick by clicking/tapping different team before matchup locks
System automatically saves changes when new pick is selected
Changes are immediately reflected in user's submission
System prevents editing picks after individual matchup lock time has passed
Visual indicator shows which matchups are still editable vs locked

stories.title: View Lock Times for Each Matchup
stories.goal: see when each matchup locks so I know my deadline for picks
stories.benefit: I can manage my time and make informed decisions about when to finalize picks
acceptanceCriteria: Each matchup displays its individual lock time based on game start time
Lock times are shown in user's local timezone
System displays countdown timer or time remaining until lock for upcoming matchups
Locked matchups are clearly marked with visual indicator (e.g., lock icon, grayed out)
System shows both date and time for matchups more than 24 hours away
Lock times automatically update as game times approach

stories.title: Choose Not to Participate in Pick'ems for a Week
stories.goal: skip submitting picks for a week without penalty or forced participation
stories.benefit: I have flexibility to participate when I want without being required to pick every week
acceptanceCriteria: System does not require user to submit picks for any week
User can view pick'ems interface without being forced to make selections
Non-participation does not generate error messages or warnings
User's stats and leaderboard position reflect only weeks they participated
System does not create default or auto-generated picks for non-participants
User can still view results and others' picks even if they didn't participate

stories.title: Hide Other Users' Picks Until Lock
stories.goal: make my picks without seeing what others have chosen before lock time
stories.benefit: I make independent predictions without being influenced by others' selections
acceptanceCriteria: System does not display other users' picks before matchup lock time
Pick'ems page only shows current user's own selections before lock
Other users' participation status (picked/not picked) is not visible before lock
System prevents API or data inspection from revealing others' picks early
Privacy is maintained for all matchups until their individual lock times
System shows clear message that others' picks will be revealed after lock

stories.title: View Others' Picks After Lock Time
stories.goal: see what other users picked for locked matchups
stories.benefit: I can compare my predictions with others and engage in friendly competition
acceptanceCriteria: System reveals all users' picks for each matchup after it locks
Revealed picks show which users picked which team with visual breakdown (e.g., percentage, list)
System displays pick distribution for each matchup (e.g., '7 picked Team A, 3 picked Team B')
User can see individual picks of specific members if desired
Revealed picks update automatically when lock time is reached without page refresh
System maintains historical view of all users' picks for locked matchups

stories.title: Receive Confirmation of Pick Submission
stories.goal: know that my picks were successfully saved and recorded
stories.benefit: I have confidence that my selections will be graded and counted
acceptanceCriteria: System displays confirmation message after successful pick submission or update
Confirmation indicates number of matchups picked and time of submission
User can view summary of their submitted picks on confirmation
System sends browser notification or visual feedback for successful save
Failed submissions display clear error message with reason and retry option
Confirmation persists briefly then allows user to continue browsing

stories.title: View My Pick Status Summary
stories.goal: see an overview of which matchups I have picked and which are pending
stories.benefit: I can quickly identify incomplete picks and ensure I don't miss any matchups
acceptanceCriteria: System displays progress indicator showing picked matchups vs total matchups
Summary shows which specific matchups have picks and which are empty
Visual distinction between picked, unpicked, and locked matchups
User can access this summary from main pick'ems page
Summary updates in real-time as user makes or changes picks
System highlights unpicked matchups approaching lock time

stories.title: Handle Late Access After Some Matchups Lock
stories.goal: still submit picks for unlocked matchups even if some games have already started
stories.benefit: I can participate partially if I missed earlier deadlines
acceptanceCriteria: System allows picks for any matchup that has not yet locked
Locked matchups are clearly marked and disabled from selection
User can see results of locked matchups while picking remaining games
System calculates partial participation in grading and stats
Late submissions are timestamped and reflect actual participation window
User sees clear indication of which matchups are still available for picks

stories.title: Access Pick'ems from Multiple Devices
stories.goal: submit or edit my picks from any device with my selections synchronized
stories.benefit: I have flexibility to participate from desktop, mobile, or tablet seamlessly
acceptanceCriteria: User's picks are stored in database and accessible from any logged-in device
Changes made on one device are immediately reflected on other devices
System prevents conflicting edits if user is logged in on multiple devices simultaneously
Pick'ems interface is fully responsive and functional on mobile browsers
User can start picks on one device and finish on another without data loss
System maintains consistent state across all devices in real-time

stories.title: View Historical Picks from Previous Weeks
stories.goal: review my past picks from completed weeks
stories.benefit: I can track my prediction accuracy over time and learn from my choices
acceptanceCriteria: User can navigate to previous weeks to view their historical picks
Historical picks are displayed with actual game outcomes for comparison
System shows which picks were correct (green) and incorrect (red) with visual indicators
User can see their pick compared to actual result and other users' picks
Historical picks are read-only and cannot be edited after lock
System maintains complete pick history for all participated weeks

stories.title: Receive Reminder Before Lock Deadline
stories.user: League Member Who Has Not Submitted Picks
stories.goal: get notified when the pick'ems deadline is approaching
stories.benefit: I don't miss the chance to participate because I forgot about the deadline
acceptanceCriteria: System sends notification or displays banner when first matchup lock is approaching (e.g., 1 hour before)
Reminder indicates how many matchups are unpicked and time remaining
User can configure reminder preferences or opt out of reminders
Reminders are sent via in-app notification, email, or browser notification based on settings
System only sends reminders to users who have not completed picks for upcoming week
Multiple reminders can be configured for different time thresholds
